# Auto-Generated Opaque Keys + Soft Delete

## Keys

ArangoDB auto-generates all `_key` values. Keys carry no functional load. Meaningful
identifiers (`DD-ARCH-09`), content hashes, and source file paths are indexed fields,
not keys.

Meaningful keys couple document identity to content structure — any rename, split,
merge, or format change breaks edges. Auto-generated keys eliminate this class of
problem entirely.

## Soft Delete

Vertices are soft-deleted (`deleted_at` = timestamp), not hard-deleted. All queries
filter `deleted_at == null`. A `docdog gc` command permanently removes documents
older than N hours. `docdog gc --undo` rolls back recent soft-deletes.

Cheap safety net: if the indexer crashes mid-re-index (after delete, before re-insert),
soft-deleted data is recoverable. Not version history — just a trash bin with a timer.
